title: Zero Gravity Kitchen
prompt:
[Intro: funk bass and clap pattern, filtered disco strings]

[Verse 1: cool, low, tight groove]
Friday night and we've got nowhere to be
Radio's on something from seventy-three
You slide past the stove in your socks on the tile
I haven't seen you move like that in a while

[Pre-Chorus: strings open up, kick drops out]
Who needs a rocket? Who needs the stars?
We've got a floor and it's ours

[Chorus: claps on a skipping rhythm, full disco groove]
We've got a zero gravity kitchen
Socks on the tile and the radio's hissing
Spin me round by the fridge, I'm lifting
Feet off the floor
Come on, my honeybun astronaut
Dishes can wait, they can wait a lot
Zero gravity, zero gravity kitchen

[Verse 2: cool, amused]
Kettle's our engine, the tap is the rain
The dog thinks we've both gone gently insane
You dip me so low that I'm counting the crumbs
I'm laughing too hard to say when the landing comes

[Pre-Chorus: strings open up, kick drops out]
Who needs a rocket? Who needs the stars?
We've got a floor and it's ours

[Chorus: claps on a skipping rhythm, full disco groove]
We've got a zero gravity kitchen
Socks on the tile and the radio's hissing
Spin me round by the fridge, I'm lifting
Feet off the floor
Come on, my honeybun astronaut
Dishes can wait, they can wait a lot
Zero gravity, zero gravity kitchen

[Bridge: talk-sung over bass and claps, like a countdown]
Ten, nine, turn it up
Eight, seven, put that down
Six, five, four, come here
Three, two, one

[Final Chorus: everything, string runs, crowd claps]
We've got a zero gravity kitchen
Socks on the tile and the radio's hissing
Spin me round by the fridge, I'm lifting
Feet off the floor
Come on, my honeybun astronaut
Dishes can wait, they can wait a lot
Zero gravity, zero gravity kitchen

[Outro: bass and claps, a plate clinking, a laugh]
Lift-off
